instruction: Generate BPMN 2.0 XML for the described process.
input: Order approval: start, receive order, check order, if approved then fulfill order, else notify customer, then end.
output:
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Defs_OrderApproval" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn">
  <process id="Process_OrderApproval" name="Order Approval" isExecutable="false">
    <startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start"/>
    <task id="Task_Receive" name="Receive Order"/>
    <task id="Task_Check" name="Check Order"/>
    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approved" name="Approved?"/>
    <task id="Task_Fulfill" name="Fulfill Order"/>
    <task id="Task_Notify" name="Notify Customer"/>
    <endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="End"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Receive"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Receive" targetRef="Task_Check"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Approved"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Approved" targetRef="Task_Fulfill">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[approved]]></conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Approved" targetRef="Task_Notify">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[rejected]]></conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Fulfill" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
  </process>
</definitions>

instruction: Generate BPMN 2.0 XML for the described process.
input: Invoice payment with reminder: start, send invoice, wait 48 hours, if paid then close, else send reminder and close, then end.
output:

  <process id="Process_Invoice" name="Invoice Payment" isExecutable="false">
    <startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start"/>
    <task id="Task_Send" name="Send Invoice"/>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Wait" name="Wait 48 Hours">
      <timerEventDefinition>
        <timeDuration>PT48H</timeDuration>
      </timerEventDefinition>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Paid" name="Paid?"/>
    <task id="Task_Close" name="Close Invoice"/>
    <task id="Task_Remind" name="Send Reminder"/>
    <endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="End"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Send"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Send" targetRef="Event_Wait"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Event_Wait" targetRef="Gateway_Paid"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Paid" targetRef="Task_Close">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[paid]]></conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Paid" targetRef="Task_Remind">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[unpaid]]></conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Remind" targetRef="Task_Close"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Close" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
  </process>
</definitions>

        <timeDuration>PT24H</timeDuration>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Work" targetRef="Task_Complete"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="Task_Complete"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Complete" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
  </process>
</definitions>
